'''Tallo''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who was the eldest son of [[Bordon]], and the older brother of [[Wend]].

==Biography==
In [[1000 BBY/Legends|1000 BBY]], he joined his father, brother, and the [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Irtanna]] on a rescue effort on his homeworld of [[Ruusan/Legends|Ruusan]] after the [[Seventh Battle of Ruusan]], aboard the [[Envoy-class shuttle|''Envoy''-class shuttle]] ''[[Star-Wake]]''.

After the crew picked up [[Darth Zannah/Legends|Darth Zannah]]&mdash;of whose allegiance to the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] they were unaware&mdash;during one of the rescue missions, Tallo was [[Death/Legends|killed]] by the [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]] after struggling with her over a [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]]. Following his death, Zannah murdered the rest of the crew of the ''Star-Wake'' as well.
